title: When you are grateful
line: For good days, answered prayers, and simple thanks.
intro: Joy and gratitude deserve a practice too. This one is short and bright: a morning verse, an offering, and a moment to say thank you.

steps.title: Light the lamp
steps.text: Light a real diya if you have one, or this one. Let the flame be the centre of your attention for a moment.

steps.title: Look at your hands
steps.text: Look at your open hands as you read: Lakshmi, Saraswati and Govinda dwell in them.

steps.title: A simple offering
steps.text: Whatever is offered with love, a leaf, a flower, water, is received.

steps.title: Thank you
steps.prompt: What am I thankful for today?

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Read the closing prayer once, slowly. Then sit for one more breath before you return to your day.

after: Share the good news with someone. Joy grows when it is shared.
